headline: Argentine Sovereign Bonds and Equities Rally on Fiscal and Payment Clarity
summary: Argentine public titles rose 1.9% on average after Economy Minister Caputo detailed plans for upcoming January bond payments, while the S&P Merval gained 0.6% and the official dollar reached a record high.
why: Clarity on sovereign debt servicing schedules and fiscal adjustment paths reduces default risk perceptions, driving short-term recoveries in local fixed-income and equity assets.

impacts.name: MSCI Merval Index
impacts.why: Positive sentiment regarding debt servicing plans buoys local equity valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Announcements detailing the execution mechanisms for upcoming sovereign debt payments reassured investors regarding short-term fiscal solvency.
